summary: Three Looks for Thanksgiving, Harvest Moon, Turkey Trot and Hearthside: each has its own animated scene (a harvest moon over the wheat; turkeys on parade at sundown; a fire in a brick hearth, with a cat asleep on the rug), pointer set and effects. The three scenes are also under Settings → Background → Scene. Halloween's Graveyard and Pumpkin Patch moved to the Looks gallery. They stay on wherever you already wear them, and their scenes and pointers stay in Settings. Blackboard: submission status on Activity cards, and the tasks on course cards, show when you open the page within two minutes of another Blackboard page. In 4.0.7 they were drawn and taken away again, over and over.
